name: smwgraphics-yoshi-s-island-ds-1
title: Yoshi's Island DS - 1-1
description:
This BG was shown at Winter C3 2023. What's worse is that there was no screenshot of it. I decided to draw it using screenshots from the game. It was unpleasant, as it took some tries, but it's done. The hills have received a different makeover, but should look good nevertheless. BG is animated.

Uses the second half of palette row 6.

Update: I updated this BG for Winter C3 2025. Uses less tiles, it comes with 2 sample files and the second sample file has layer 3.

Best of all, it's compatible with this tileset.
